title: v2 operations, finance, privacy and research evidence proposal
validation_bounds: The cited pytest sets overlap and their case counts must not be added as unique tests.
Owned database fixtures use isolated SQLite; root owns separate current-schema PostgreSQL startup, restore and contention evidence.
HTTP/provider behavior is mocked or synthetic; no live supplier receipt, outbound message, payment, carrier call or subject consent was created.
Research tests use synthetic non-speech PCM and fake model behavior; actual licensed weights, field quality and deployed-hardware measurements remain gates.
Local evidence does not establish legal approval, clinical approval, staffed on-call delivery outside the application, offsite backup custody or causal business lift.

status_policy.implemented_unverified: Partially implemented and/or full stated acceptance not demonstrated. Read remaining_acceptance; this status does not mean all required code exists.
status_policy.verified_local: The named local software/document behavior is supported by explicit tests or inspection within acceptance_limits. This is not external provider, deployment, legal, clinical, commercial or representative research validation.
status_policy.verified_external: Real deployed/provider/customer evidence supports the stated acceptance.
status_policy.blocked_external: Work depends on a specifically missing external account, rights, infrastructure, person or observation.
status_policy.deferred_by_product_gate: Original blueprint explicitly places feature behind an unmet product/evidence gate; retain exact rationale.
status_policy.not_applicable_with_reason: Explicit controlling decision removes applicability; never a silent omission.

test_runs.scope: Focused synthetic offline teacher comparison and human-adjudication integrity/privacy tests. No real teacher/provider, patient corpus, human review or training run.

research_run_observed.evidence_type: successful_session_tool_result; root final full-suite JUnit supersedes

requirements.title: Abuse quotas
requirements.acceptance: SMS flooding, repeated holds/calls and expensive outbound routes are limited without biometric profiling.
requirements.verified_behavior: Adds exact monetary reservations, per-call/provider/month bounds, receipt-aware retry liability and prefix-allowed bounded outbound reminders to the existing shared call/hold/message quotas. Automated media reserves the bounded remaining call duration before access; repeat admission over budget rejects and actual expiry preserves UNKNOWN carrier liability. Unpriced development is explicit; production requires approved current rates and enabled limits.
acceptance_limits: This assessment owns money and outreach limits; merge core evidence for shared concurrency, call duration, hold and ingress quotas.
Upstream carrier/PBX charges are not bounded by application code alone; logical elapsed time does not settle a carrier bill.
remaining_acceptance: Set actual supplier rates and upstream carrier/PBX account caps.
external_dependencies: Set actual supplier rates and upstream carrier/PBX account caps.
requirements.scope: v2 operations/finance/privacy/research implementation; merge core/frontend/deployment evidence separately.

requirements.title: Usage event ledger
requirements.acceptance: Unique source/call/tenant events record meter, quantity, unit, rate version, currency and adjustments.
requirements.verified_behavior: Exact decimal quantities and approved price/FX/quanta produce integer micro-Toman events. Tenant/provider/meter/operation and provider receipt identities deduplicate charges. Rates and ledger evidence reject ORM mutation; corrections append linked adjustments. Browser display has exact decimal-string money. An accepted provider result and any exact returned charge remain durable if the clinic is disabled during I/O; settlement locks the existing tenant/reservation and does not require a still-active admission state.
acceptance_limits: Application append-only enforcement does not claim a privileged database administrator cannot alter evidence.
Rates are operator-entered documented assumptions until reconciled to actual supplier receipts.
remaining_acceptance: Publish actual approved supplier rate versions and validate production reconciliation against authenticated receipts.
external_dependencies: Publish actual approved supplier rate versions and validate production reconciliation against authenticated receipts.
requirements.scope: v2 operations/finance/privacy/research implementation; merge core/frontend/deployment evidence separately.

requirements.title: Correct call denominators
requirements.acceptance: Attempted, connected, answered, eligible, resolved, confirmed and kept are defined distinctly.
requirements.verified_behavior: Authenticated transport event ingestion counts distinct attempted/connected/answered/eligible/resolved/busy/rejected/abandoned attempts; application bookings and attendance are separate UTC creation cohorts. Missing transport inventory returns null rather than a manufactured answer rate.
acceptance_limits: Only supplied transport events are counted; application session creation is not carrier answer evidence.
Confirmed-or-kept and kept booking cohorts are explicit, separate from transport attempt stages.
remaining_acceptance: Connect and reconcile actual CDR/event inventory for carrier-wide denominator coverage.
external_dependencies: Connect and reconcile actual CDR/event inventory for carrier-wide denominator coverage.

requirements.title: Invoice reconciliation
requirements.acceptance: Vendor receipts reconcile to tenant/provider usage with explicit discrepancy and dispute workflow.
requirements.verified_behavior: Bounded immutable vendor statements match exact quantity/unit/currency/cost and expose mismatches. Operator dispute/review stores encrypted explanations; accepted differences append adjustments. Previously recorded native-receipt adjustments are included so later statements do not charge twice.
acceptance_limits: Imported vendor evidence and review decisions are operator attestations; tests use synthetic invoices.
No vendor account, invoice authenticity or payment was independently verified.
remaining_acceptance: Import and verify real vendor statements, contract rates, taxes and dispute receipts.
external_dependencies: Import and verify real vendor statements, contract rates, taxes and dispute receipts.
requirements.scope: v2 operations/finance/privacy/research implementation; merge core/frontend/deployment evidence separately.

requirements.title: Cost budget enforcement
requirements.acceptance: Soft alerts/hard caps and humane fallback include retries, silence and provider-specific charge units.
requirements.verified_behavior: Tenant-serialized maximum-cost reservations enforce monthly, per-call, per-operation and provider caps; latest policy is rechecked before first dispatch. Started requests cannot dispatch again. Uncertain charges retain liability across month boundaries. Actual overruns remain visible and alert staff. STT/TTS/calendar/SMS/digest/outbound voice use explicit meters. Automated SIP/WebRTC admission reserves bounded remaining duration before access, then disconnect/expiry records logical elapsed time including silence while keeping carrier liability UNKNOWN until evidenced reconciliation. Clinic deactivation blocks new reservations, starts and queued dispatch, while settlement of an existing authorized attempt preserves accepted results and charges without authorizing further work.
acceptance_limits: Hard limits constrain new application-admitted requests; they cannot undo supplier charges already incurred.
Automated media admission does not bound upstream ringing, rejected calls, human-only PBX activity or an entire carrier account.
Logical elapsed time is not a final supplier charge; explicit evidence settles the retained liability.
remaining_acceptance: Validate real carrier billing quanta and independent PBX/provider account toll limits.
external_dependencies: Validate real carrier billing quanta and independent PBX/provider account toll limits.
requirements.scope: v2 operations/finance/privacy/research implementation; merge core/frontend/deployment evidence separately.

requirements.title: Deduplicated attribution
requirements.acceptance: Repeat callers, displaced bookings and waitlist replacements are not double-counted as recovered demand.
requirements.verified_behavior: Attribution uses an opaque demand episode, never phone identity alone. Distinct kept new-demand episodes deduplicate repeat attempts; moved/displaced/replacement outcomes require a related booking. Waitlist fills cannot be classified as new demand. Causal incremental kept demand remains null.
acceptance_limits: Episode and classification labels require truthful review; the application does not infer causal lift from a booking.
Shared family phones are not treated as one person or demand episode.
remaining_acceptance: Collect matched, representative clinic cohorts and review episode attribution against actual calendar outcomes.
external_dependencies: Collect matched, representative clinic cohorts and review episode attribution against actual calendar outcomes.
requirements.scope: v2 operations/finance/privacy/research implementation; merge core/frontend/deployment evidence separately.

requirements.title: Staff workload accounting
requirements.acceptance: Time released distinguishes avoidable labor cost from reassigned work and deducts supervision/rework.
requirements.verified_behavior: Observed staff timers prevent overlap across clinics and pin declared hourly rate. Released, avoidable and reassigned minutes are separate reviewed observations; supervision/rework deduct from avoidable value. Abandoned timers over 16 hours require bounded evidence-backed correction and can then release the user for new work.
acceptance_limits: Timer observation and declared labor rate do not establish actual cash savings or staffing reduction.
The web Costs page does not include a dedicated staff workload study panel; the versioned workload endpoints are available.
remaining_acceptance: Execute an actual time study with payroll/capacity evidence and independently verify any avoidable labor savings.
external_dependencies: Execute an actual time study with payroll/capacity evidence and independently verify any avoidable labor savings.

A real gateway must enforce duration, idempotency and route controls itself.

requirements.title: Redacted tracing

requirements.verified_behavior: Durable tenant-scoped traces correlate call, turn, provider, booking, parent event and notification IDs with bounded measurements and version metadata. acceptance_limits: Coverage includes instrumented paths only; trace absence does not prove an event did not occur.
Root/core media timing evidence remains separate from generic HTTP timing.

requirements.title: Backup automation

requirements.verified_behavior: Authenticated encrypted configuration backup preserves selected file hashes and metadata-only key-custody inventory under a separate private key; restore verifies hashes first, refuses overwrite/path escape and writes private permissions. Root integrates versioned full-model database backup/restore and automated worker entrypoints.
acceptance_limits: Owned tests prove local encrypted config file recovery only; root owns actual current-schema database restore/retention evidence.
Tooling does not create an offsite copy, obtain custody from a real key custodian or restart a real recovered production deployment.

requirements.title: Purpose-specific consent
requirements.acceptance: Processing, recording, QA, marketing, training and cross-border permissions have independent evidence/version.
requirements.verified_behavior: Ten independently published purposes have version/notice/retention/expiry settings. Staff evidence records a specific verified subject choice, document hash and method. Processing does not authorize recording, QA, marketing, training or cross-border use; withdrawal blocks optional use and ends matching active processing calls. Non-demo public session admission requires the exact displayed processing notice fingerprint under the tenant fence; stale or missing notice binding rejects before session creation, and ongoing AI turns reject a disabled processing purpose.
acceptance_limits: Evidence references are staff attestations, not independently authenticated signatures.
Demo omission of notice binding remains explicitly unbound compatibility. Browser fingerprint matching does not independently prove telephony disclosure or actual legally valid optional consent.
remaining_acceptance: Obtain actual subject permissions and appropriate legal/clinical review for the intended deployment.
external_dependencies: Obtain actual subject permissions and appropriate legal/clinical review for the intended deployment.

requirements.title: Retention scheduler
requirements.acceptance: Per-purpose expiry acts on records/audio/exports and records deletion evidence and backup-expiry obligations.
requirements.verified_behavior: Encrypted governed transcript/export/QA/audio artifacts require purpose-specific permission and expire through a bounded worker. Administrative call content observes the shortest current tenant, published processing-purpose and original pinned retention limit; the public notice and new-session snapshot use the same helper. Withdrawal expires optional content. Local deletion evidence records content hash, backup deadline and pending backup status. Legal holds do not authorize access or starve other expiry work; disabled clinics still erase content. External-calendar erasure removes direct contact fields while retaining necessary committed calendar truth and uncertain-write review evidence.
acceptance_limits: Runtime transcript expiry covers ended administrative calls and retires access credentials; structured financial, business and audit evidence has distinct obligations.
The worker cap is per clinic; all clinics are traversed in stable order and no fixed total runtime is claimed.
Backup deletion is not inferred from elapsed time; attestation is distinct from local erasure.
Remote calendar records retain minimal structured business evidence necessary for cancellation/readback.
remaining_acceptance: Execute actual retained-backup expiry/erasure and any legal hold review.
external_dependencies: Execute actual retained-backup expiry/erasure and any legal hold review.
requirements.scope: v2 operations/finance/privacy/research implementation; merge core/frontend/deployment evidence separately.

requirements.title: Teacher label QA
requirements.acceptance: Independent teacher outputs and human adjudication distinguish agreement from actual ground truth.
requirements.verified_behavior: Offline import compares two to five distinctly identified and explicitly attested teacher systems against an exact, currently revalidated frozen manifest. It checks audio/content/manifest hashes, expiry and region evidence before processing hypotheses, reports exact/normalized/digit disagreements and missing coverage separately, and never treats agreement as ground truth. Every sample needs a separate content-bound human accept/exclude decision, qualified/authorized reviewer evidence, timestamps and listening/privacy attestations for acceptance. Input mutation, stale comparisons, missing decisions, withdrawal, duplicate JSON keys and overwrite attempts are rejected; outputs contain no raw hypothesis/transcript or reviewer identity and use private file permissions.
acceptance_limits: All 25 focused acceptance cases use synthetic non-speech tones and fictional teacher/reviewer metadata; no real multi-teacher recognition, actual listening or acoustic-truth observation is implied.

Independence, permissions, licenses, human identity, qualifications and review actions remain accountable attestations. Hashes and booleans establish artifact integrity, not the external truth of those attestations.
The tool supports QA/relabeling of already eligible frozen samples; raw unreviewed captures cannot bypass dataset privacy/rights gates.

No providers/models are called, no audio/transcript is copied into reports, no dataset is rewritten, and training_ready remains false. Revised labels need a new privacy-reviewed freeze and current withdrawal checks.
Per invocation limits are 500 samples, two to five teachers, 16 MB per JSON input and 2,000 characters/256 normalized words per hypothesis.
remaining_acceptance: Provide an authorized representative corpus and actual independent teacher hypotheses with verified rights/region/model/license evidence.
Have qualified, authorized reviewers perform and document the real listening, correction, privacy review and exclusions, then re-freeze and evaluate the revised corpus.
external_dependencies: Real corpus permission, selected teacher licenses/processor authorization and accountable independent human reviewers.
requirements.scope: v2 operations/finance/privacy/research implementation; local software completion does not satisfy actual research-data/people gates.
